messages.title: Fenced code in several languages, with a long line
messages.author: assistant
messages.text:
Here is the same check in a few languages.

```go
func isJammed(rate float64, expected float64) bool {
	return rate < expected*0.5 // a line that is long enough to need the code block to scroll sideways rather than wrap
}
```

```ts
export function isJammed(rate: number, expected: number): boolean {
  return rate < expected * 0.5;
}
```

```python
def is_jammed(rate: float, expected: float) -> bool:
    return rate < expected * 0.5
```

```bash
curl -s https://api.example.com/rate | jq '.rate'
```

```json
{ "station": "pick-1", "rate": 412, "isJammed": false }
```

```yaml
station: pick-1
rate: 412
isJammed: false
```

```sql
SELECT station, avg(rate) FROM pick_rate WHERE hour >= 6 GROUP BY station;
```

messages.title: Mermaid flowchart, sequence, state and gantt
messages.author: assistant
messages.text:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Inspect[Inspect gripper] --> Decide{Pads worn?}
  Decide -- yes --> Replace[Replace pads]
  Decide -- no --> Run[Start line]
  Replace --> Run
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  Operator->>Planner: Start order
  Planner->>Robot: Pick plan
  Robot-->>Planner: Done
```

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Picking
  Picking --> Idle
  Picking --> Faulted
  Faulted --> Idle
```

```mermaid
gantt
  dateFormat HH:mm
  axisFormat %H:%M
  section Line
  Warm up :a1, 06:00, 30m
  Picking :after a1, 4h
```

messages.title: Inline and display math, and dollar amounts that stay text
messages.author: assistant
messages.text:
The pick rate is $r = \frac{n}{t}$ and its spread is

$$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}(r_i - \bar{r})^2}$$

The spare pads cost $5 and $10 a pair, which is money, not math.
